Policy on the restless session
Staff will learn the plain rules
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: This section sets the handling rules for animal travel, reception, and transfer within Aurelia Skyways service points. Staff must keep each case calm, orderly, and safe, and must give patient attention to every animal under care.

The desk accepts animals only after the traveler has completed the required check-in steps and the baggage record is clear. The safety coordinator reviews hazards before any transfer begins, and staff must follow that review without delay. If a crate, lead, or carrier shows damage, the item is to be set aside and the traveler informed at once. Staff must keep voices even, hands steady, and paths clear, and must never rush an animal through a crowded area. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and any sign of distress calls for a careful pause and a fresh check of the plan.

Staff will record service changes in the desk ledger as soon as they are approved. If a traveler asks for a change in handling, feeding, or routing, the desk will confirm what can be done and note the result in the file. <<FACT F023>> Animals moving through the lounge or relief area are to be monitored at all times, with water, shade, and cleaning supplies available where permitted. <<FACT F014>> If the animal is in the care of Talia Dubois, Anika Johnson, or a similar traveler case, the same rules apply without exception. Loki or any other pet must remain secured until staff complete the release step and the desk log is updated.

Any concern about safety, delays, missed documentation, or animal welfare must be sent to the senior coordinator before the case moves onward.
